film_p1_body: We keep your car's paint as it was on day one. This app keeps every detail of that protection in your hands.
film_p2_body: A clear TPU film stops stone chips, fine scratches, bird droppings, acid rain and UV before they reach your paint.
film_p3_body: The self-healing top coat closes fine scratches; high clarity adds depth to your paint. Your car looks new every day.
film_p4_title: Change your color, keep your paint.
film_p4_body: Give your car a new look with colored PPF. The original paint stays safe underneath.
film_p5_body: Olex films are installed only by authorized dealers, with OLEX-FIT cuts made for your car's exact shape.
film_p6_body: Even if the paper card gets lost, your warranty is on your phone. It is verified by QR and passes to the new owner when you sell.
film_p7_title: Everything about your car, in one place.
